raw: The last meal I ate was supper yesterday, at my sister’s apartment. We had chicken and rice, and the chicken was roasted with garlic cloves. That’s the part I remember best—the garlic with the chicken. The rice comes to mind after that, though I suppose I’ve told it the other way round. Food is funny that way; you remember one part and then the rest follows. I can place the meal at her apartment more easily than I can remember what we talked about.
